name: metka
description: Short labels for Bash commands from Metka, a small local model, written over the command as it runs

url.title: Labeller server
url.description: A llama-server, or any server with the OpenAI completions API, serving a Metka model

minConfidence.title: Least confidence
minConfidence.description: A label whose least likely word is under this probability is cut back or not shown (0 turns it off)

skipDescription.title: Ask Claude to skip descriptions
skipDescription.description: Tell the model to leave out Bash's description field, which Metka's label replaces; saves output tokens
